title: sleep-edf BPB_SCORES payload
description: Flat {str:number} JSON emitted by checks/evaluate_external.py between the BPB_SCORES sentinels. score = test_kappa (Cohen's kappa on subjects 16-19, clipped to [0,1]); test_accuracy / test_balanced_accuracy / test_macro_f1 are auxiliary aggregates; per-class recalls (wake/n1/n2/n3/rem) give diagnostic detail. All 10 keys line up with the eeg-sleep-staging category metric set in categories.yaml.

score.description: Primary leaderboard metric = Cohen's kappa on subjects 16-19, clipped to [0,1]. Kappa can be negative for pathological classifiers; clipping to 0 keeps the leaderboard bounded.

test_kappa.description: Cohen's kappa on the concatenated subject-16..19 predictions; may be negative for very bad classifiers.

test_balanced_accuracy.description: Balanced accuracy (macro-recall) on subjects 16-19; robust to Wake dominance.

wake_recall.description: Per-class recall for Wake (label 0) on subjects 16-19.

n1_recall.description: Per-class recall for N1 (label 1) on subjects 16-19; typically the hardest class.

n2_recall.description: Per-class recall for N2 (label 2) on subjects 16-19.

n3_recall.description: Per-class recall for N3 = merged stage 3+4 (label 3) on subjects 16-19.

rem_recall.description: Per-class recall for REM (label 4) on subjects 16-19.
